author: Sagaracg
title: Please introduce more stable money loading options
review_text: The only reason i stopped using esewa and switched to khalti is that the money loading methods in esewa are not reliable and it takes a long time and a lot of effort to get that money back.  Khalti has connectips integration and connect ips is so reliable that i only have had one transaction that had an issue in the past 2 years i have been using it. And for that too the money was back within 2 minutes automatically.  I admire esewa as it started the wallet revolution in nepal but i cant justify using it unless the mechanism to load money is reliable and doesn’t waste hours of my time trying to get it resolved.   I really don’t understand why esewa doesn’t have a connect ips integration
